# Why won't this QFX / OFX file import?

> Free OFX and QFX file checker: finds the problems that make QuickBooks, Quicken, YNAB and Xero reject a bank or credit-card Web Connect file — bad header, unclosed tags, duplicate FITIDs, invalid dates and amounts, unescaped ampersands, DTSTART and DTEND mismatches — and writes the file back fixed.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
